race.comment: BLUISH HUE (2) smart gelding who was a month between runs when he jumped in trip for a slashing nose second over 1600m here last Saturday. Blinkers go on and shapes as one of the better bets on the card. PARTY BOSS (6) two runs back on the country tracks have been solid and ready for this distance from the right draw. Jumped in grade and trip with a fighting on speed second over 1300m at Wagga in a BM74. Placed at the distance and deserves his chance here. MAGIC MERLIN (5) Scone-trained mare who will relish the fast tempo deep into her prep. Drifted back along the inside and warmed up strongly out wide with a tidy eighth over 1500m at Rosehill in this grade. Capable of much better. BONNIE MURRINGO (15) gets in light with Grima's claim and can give plenty of cheek.
